annotations.description: Mulliganed a functional 7-card hand with 5 lands, a 3-drop creature, and premium removal. While land-heavy, the hand curves out with Prickly Marmoset on turn 3 and Deem Worthy on turn 5, and will naturally draw into more spells. Going to 6 risks a worse hand.

annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. Three lands with powerful 5 and 6 drops is acceptable in Limited. Draw steps 1-4 give good chances to find early plays.

annotations.betterLine: Bottom Rodolf Duskbringer instead - it's the most expensive card and won't be castable for many turns with only 2 lands. Blood Price at 4 mana would help dig for the missing lands and White sources needed for Daybreak Charger and Valorous Steed.

annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without playing a land, ending the turn with 0 lands on the battlefield.
annotations.betterLine: Play an Island to have 1 mana available and be on track to curve out with Warden of Evos Isle on turn 3.

annotations.description: MstMed Spike timed out and failed to cast any spell with 3 untapped Islands. At 12 life facing an opponent with creatures on board, developing the board is critical. Missing this play wastes an entire turn's mana and delays the game plan significantly.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out and passed without casting anything.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Warden of Evos Isle for {2}{U} to get a 2/2 flyer on board as a blocker and cost reducer for future flying creatures like Tide Skimmer and Inniaz.

annotations.description: Spike is stuck on 3 lands with a hand full of 4-5 mana spells (Inniaz, Roaming Ghostlight, Tide Skimmer, Rooting Moloch all cost 4-5 mana). At 12 life facing Bloodthirsty Aerialist and Daybreak Charger, they desperately need to find lands to start deploying threats. Cycling Rooting Moloch for {2} would dig toward a land drop while Spike is mana-screwed.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without cycling Rooting Moloch
annotations.betterLine: Cycle Rooting Moloch for {2} to dig for a 4th land. Finding land enables Warden of Evos Isle next turn (which then makes the 5-mana flyers cheaper). Staying on 3 lands means continuing to do nothing while the opponent builds their board and pressures Spike's 12 life total.

annotations.description: Discarded Rooting Moloch, which has Cycling {2} (payable with just Islands), over Reptilian Reflection, which requires both red mana to be on the battlefield AND cycling cards to function. annotations.betterLine: Discard Reptilian Reflection, which requires both red mana and cycling synergy to function, keeping Rooting Moloch's cheap cycling ability as a way to dig for land drops and red sources.

annotations.description: At 7 life facing 5 damage (2/3 flying Bloodthirsty Aerialist + 3/1 Daybreak Charger), declining to cast Unsubstantiate on the Aerialist drops Spike to 2 life instead of 4 life. At 2 life, Spike dies to virtually any attack next turn. Bouncing the Aerialist also removes the most dangerous threat (flying creature that grows with life gain) and forces opponent to spend 3 mana recasting it.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, taking the full 5 damage and going to 2 life.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Unsubstantiate targeting Bloodthirsty Aerialist to bounce it, taking only 3 damage (going to 4 life) and forcing opponent to recast the growing flyer. This buys crucial time and survival margin while Spike develops their board with Warden of Evos Isle and flying creatures.
